text: The engine is back: the new GitHub machine (run 39010011338) is accepted by Novig, key active at 16 reads a second with the websocket on, and its scan is moving (177 of 4,965 prices in 24 s). Two bugs you spotted, being fixed now: (1) the Engine tab's Address tile said 'accepted' because it read a counter of past swaps, not the real verdict. It will now show REFUSED in red when the Novig line says refused; (2) the automatic machine swap didn't fire. I added an outside watchdog (every 5 min) that restarts a run whose address is refused for 5+ minutes, and logging to find why the built-in swap missed. Shipping as the next version.
